description: Inventory of bundled media and offline resource roots. Legacy private APK imports require LEGACY_REPOS_TOKEN.
notes: Original media files are kept byte-for-byte; no image/audio/video is recompressed by the import process.
Exact duplicates are reported by SHA-256. Perceptual matches are candidates only and are never deleted automatically.
The current official-site snapshot contains images and audio but no videos; old private APK repositories must be read to recover additional media.
All inventoried files are verified inside the APK by android-app/tools/verify_apk_media.py.
